summary: In the main deck, Cypher pours Neo a drink and reveals that Morpheus has previously believed five other men were the One, all of whom died fighting Agents. Cypher advises Neo to run from Agents rather than fight. Neo drinks and leaves. The scene cuts to a restaurant where Cypher eats a steak while Agent Smith negotiates a deal with him.

what_changes.before: Unsure about why he is there
what_changes.after: Aware that he is the sixth candidate for the One and that the previous five died
what_changes.evidence: Five.  Since I've been here. ... Dead.  All dead.

what_changes.after: Accepts the reality of the previous failures and prepares to leave
what_changes.evidence: Neo gulps down another shot. ... Cypher nods as Neo heads for the ladder.

what_changes.before: Part of the crew on the ship
what_changes.after: In negotiation with Agent Smith in a restaurant
what_changes.evidence: Do we have a deal, Mr. Reagan? ... You know, I know that this steak doesn't exist.

event_hint.one_line: Cypher warns Neo of the fate of previous 'Ones' before cutting a deal with Agent Smith.
